mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, preventing levodopa metabolism and causing dangerous accumulation of dopamine and norepinephrine with risk of hypertensive crisis, arrhythmias, and serotonergic effects.
action: Absolute contraindication: do not combine; discontinue tranylcypromine at least 14 days before initiating levodopa or choose alternative antiparkinsonian agent.
